messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means the statutory holiday falls on a weekday that is adjacent to a Saturday–Sunday pair, giving you at least three consecutive days off.)

| Holiday | Date in 2023 | Observed (if weekend) | Long‑weekend span |
|---------|--------------|-----------------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sun) | Observed Mon Jan 2 | Jan 1 – 3 |
| Family Day (BC, AB, SK, MB, ON, NB, PE) | Feb 20 (Mon) | – | Feb 18 – 20 |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Fri) | – | Apr 7 – 9 |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Mon) | – | May 20 – 22 |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Sat) | Observed Mon Jul 3 | Jul 1 – 3 |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Mon) | – | Sep 2 – 4 |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Mon) | – | Oct 7 – 9 |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Sat) | Observed Mon Nov 13 | Nov 11 – 13 |
| Christmas | Dec 25 (Mon) | – | Dec 23 – 25 |

> **Note:**  
> • Some provinces observe additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.) that may create extra long weekends.  
> • “Observed” dates are the official statutory holiday dates when the actual holiday falls on a weekend.  

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app!
